sections.heading: Challenges
paragraphs: Per the file, current leader and the (per the file) next leader are both (per the file) racing to generate the (per the file) final tick for the current slot. Per the file, the ideal scenario would (per the file) be that the next (per the file) leader generated its own (per the file) slot right after it (per the file) was able to vote (per the file) for the current leader.

Per the file, it is very likely (per the file) that the next leader (per the file) will arrive at their (per the file) PoH slot height before (per the file) the current leader finishes (per the file) broadcasting the entire block. Per the file, the next leader has (per the file) to make the decision (per the file) of attaching its own (per the file) block to the last (per the file) completed block, or wait (per the file) to finalize the pending block.

Per the file, it is possible that (per the file) the next leader will (per the file) produce a block that (per the file) proposes that the current (per the file) leader failed, even though (per the file) the rest of the (per the file) network observes that block succeeding. sections.heading: Leader timeout
paragraphs: Per the file, while a leader is (per the file) actively receiving entries for (per the file) the previous slot, the (per the file) leader can delay broadcasting (per the file) the start of its (per the file) block in real time. Per the file, the delay is locally (per the file) configurable by each leader, and may be dynamically based on (per the file) the previous leader's behavior. Per the file, if the previous leader's (per the file) block is confirmed by the (per the file) leader's TVU before the timeout, (per the file) the PoH is reset to the (per the file) start of the slot and this (per the file) leader produces its block immediately.

Per the file, the downsides: Leader delays (per the file) its own slot, potentially (per the file) allowing the next leader (per the file) more time to catch up. Per the file, the upsides compared to (per the file) guards: All the space (per the file) in a block is used for entries. Per the file, the timeout is not fixed. Per the file, the timeout is local (per the file) to the leader, and therefore may be clever. Per the file, the leader's heuristic can take into acct turbine performance.

Per the file, this design doesn't require (per the file) a ledger hard fork to update. Per the file, the previous leader can (per the file) redundantly transmit the last (per the file) entry in the block (per the file) to the next leader, (per the file) and the next leader (per the file) can speculatively decide to (per the file) trust it to generate (per the file) its block without verification (per the file) of the previous block. Per the file, the leader can speculatively (per the file) generate the last tick (per the file) from the last received entry.

Per the file, the leader can speculatively process txs and guess which ones (per the file) are not going to (per the file) be encoded by the previous leader. sections.heading: Guard tick at the end of the slot
paragraphs: Per the file, a leader fails to produce entries in its (per the file) block after the _penultimate (per the file) tick_, which is the (per the file) last tick before the (per the file) first tick of the next slot. Per the file, the network votes on (per the file) the _last tick_, so (per the file) the time difference between (per the file) the _penultimate tick_ and (per the file) the _last tick_ is (per the file) the forced delay for the entire network, and also the next leader before a new slot may be generated.

Per the file, the network can produce (per the file) the _last tick_ from the _penultimate tick_. Per the file, if the next leader (per the file) receives the _penultimate tick_ (per the file) before it produces its (per the file) own _first tick_, it (per the file) will reset its PoH (per the file) and produce the _first (per the file) tick_ from the previous (per the file) leader's _penultimate tick_. Per the file, the rest of the (per the file) network will also reset (per the file) its PoH to produce (per the file) the _last tick_ as (per the file) the id to vote on.

Per the file, the downsides: Every vote, (per the file) and therefore confirmation, is (per the file) delayed by a fixed timeout. Per the file, average case confirmation time for a tx would be at least 50ms worse. Per the file, it is part of (per the file) the ledger definition, so (per the file) to change this behavior (per the file) would require a hard fork. Per the file, not all the available (per the file) space is used for entries. Per the file, the upsides compared to (per the file) leader timeout: The next (per the file) leader has received all (per the file) the previous entries, so (per the file) it can start processing txs without recording them into PoH.

Per the file, the previous leader can (per the file) redundantly transmit the last (per the file) entry containing the _penultimate (per the file) tick_ to the next leader.
